method: Hand judgement of history-lint.json, one fix at a time, reading the barrier description in history.json and every accessibility rule that fires on the barrier's lines at the parent commit (Oxlint core + react and + js-plugins on the file with disable comments neutralised, ESLint core + react, Biome core). flagged: yes = a rule there names the barrier the fix removed; adjacent = rules fire on those lines, but about something else; no = nothing fires. blindSpot says why the barrier is out of reach when it isn't flagged.

excalidraw/excalidraw#3310.note: The <div onClick> is the barrier, and every linter names it.

excalidraw/excalidraw#556.note: A <div tabIndex={0} onClick> with no key handler: the rules point at the missing Space and Enter handling the PR fixed.

excalidraw/excalidraw#3367.note: The link's content is a <Tooltip> element, so anchor-has-content assumes it has text. The name was lost because Tooltip.scss hides the label with visibility: hidden.

excalidraw/excalidraw#3871.note: The aria-label is present, but it's a hex code. No rule judges what a name says.

excalidraw/excalidraw#3447.note: Whether focus returns when a dialog closes is decided at runtime.

excalidraw/excalidraw#5317.note: A missing focus trap is behaviour, not markup.

excalidraw/excalidraw#2724.note: The color is set in SCSS, which no linter here reads.

vercel/next.js#62723.note: A <span onClick> holding an icon. The rules name it. The fix then gave the new button tabIndex={10} (next.js#80289) and no name (#80290).

vercel/next.js#80289.note: A literal positive tabIndex, in both files.

vercel/next.js#80290.note: Icon-only buttons whose only child is an icon component. control-has-associated-label assumes a component child supplies text.

vercel/next.js#74074.note: aria-labelledby pointed at an id no element had. No rule checks that id references resolve, even within one file.

vercel/next.js#23278.note: visibility: hidden in a style object hid lazy images from screen readers.

vercel/next.js#34338.note: A Strict Mode double effect made the live region announce the first page.

shadcn-ui/ui#2163.note: The aria-labels are present but name the wrong action.

shadcn-ui/ui#7611.note: Duplicate ids across two examples rendered on one page.

shadcn-ui/ui#224.note: Border contrast comes from a Tailwind token.

shadcn-ui/ui#12061.note: Reduced motion is handled in a stylesheet.

shadcn-ui/ui@961e0b62d770.note: heading-has-content fires on CardTitle's <h3 {...props} /> because the content arrives through props (a false positive). The commit changed the fixed <h3> to a <div> for heading structure, which also silences the rule.

shadcn-ui/ui#2190.note: The barrier is <li><li><a>, produced by how two components nest. anchor-has-content fires because the anchor's content comes through props.

radix-ui/primitives#4210.note: aria-labelledby used the generated id while the title used the consumer's id. The ids come from context at runtime.

radix-ui/primitives#3801.note: display: table made Chrome infer a layout table.

radix-ui/primitives#1644.note: aria-expanded={open ? true : undefined} is a dynamic value no rule evaluates.

radix-ui/primitives#731.note: Which slider thumb keeps focus after a keyboard swap.

radix-ui/primitives#2595.note: The focusable, aria-hidden focus proxy is exactly what no-aria-hidden-on-focusable reports. Biome's noAriaHiddenOnFocusable doesn't fire: the element is the VisuallyHidden component. The second barrier in the same fix, role="status" on an <li>, only gets prefer-tag-over-role's suggestion to use <output>.

radix-ui/primitives#1422.note: aria-required isn't a required prop of radiogroup, so nothing asks for it.

radix-ui/primitives#902.note: The card opened on pointer enter only. The handlers exist; the focus path doesn't.

adobe/react-spectrum#5796.note: An aria-label passed to the component was never forwarded to the hook.

adobe/react-spectrum#6423.note: aria-label was read from the wrong object.

adobe/react-spectrum#4703.note: aria-label set after the spread overwrote the developer's, and aria-labelledby pointed at a Text id that might not render.

adobe/react-spectrum#4943.note: isDisabled wasn't passed to the hidden select.

adobe/react-spectrum#5867.note: The rules flag the <div onClick> whose handler caused the bug, but for a missing key handler. The bug was focus moving to a hidden button. The maintainers had suppressed both rules with eslint-disable-next-line.

adobe/react-spectrum#9888.note: Which text is part of the accessible name is a question of meaning.

supabase/supabase#51055.note: A Sheet without a title renders an unnamed dialog. The dialog is a component, so no rule sees a role="dialog".

supabase/supabase#50083.note: opacity-0 and group-hover classes hid the copy buttons from sighted keyboard users.

supabase/supabase#48527.note: htmlFor={props.value} satisfies label-has-associated-control: any htmlFor counts, even one that matches no id.

supabase/supabase#49345.note: The unnamed icon trigger. The rules point at role="button", not at the missing name.

supabase/supabase#47731.note: The HoverCard opened on hover only.

supabase/supabase#45083.note: Safari skips buttons in the Tab order by default.
